v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
text.en: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

text.la: Beátus pópulus * cuius Dóminus Deus eius.
text.en: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

text.la: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis eius non est finis.
text.en: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

text.la: Fratres: Libénter suffértis insipiéntes, cum sitis ipsi sapiéntes: sustinétis enim si quis vos in servitútem rédigit, si quis dévorat, si quis áccipit, si quis extóllitur, si quis in fáciem vos cædit.
text.en: For you gladly suffer the foolish; whereas yourselves are wise. For you suffer if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take from you, if a man be lifted up, if a man strike you on the face.

v.la: Vespertína orátio ascéndat ad te, Dómine.
v.en: Let the evening prayer ascend unto thee, O Lord.

r.la: Et descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.
r.en: And let there descend upon us thy mercy.

text.la: Dixit Dóminus * ad Noë: Finis univérsæ carnis venit coram me: fac tibi arcam de lignis lævigátis, ut salvétur univérsum semen in ea.
text.en: The Lord said unto Noah: * The end of all flesh is come before Me, make thee an ark of planed timber, that seed of all flesh may be saved therein.

text.la: Deus, qui cónspicis, quia ex nulla nostra actióne confídimus: concéde propítius; ut, contra advérsa ómnia Doctóris géntium protectióne muniámur.
text.en: O God, Who seest that we put not our trust in anything that we do, mercifully grant that through the protection of the Teacher of the Gentiles we may be defended against all adversity.
